{{Top|leg}}
'''Model Dx5 security doors''' were blast doors which included an artificial intelligence with a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocoder]] and [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] set in them. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] had little patience with the model.

The [[model Dz5 security door]] was a virtually identical model of security door with enhanced defenses, including [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].
